name: Eumycetoma (itraconazole)
advice: Confirm fungal grains (black/white) by microscopy/culture; X-ray/MRI to check bone. Itraconazole is continued for at least 9–12 months and surgical debulking is planned after about 6 months. LFT monthly; report breathlessness or leg swelling. Wear footwear; avoid thorn injuries.

ref: Wolverton 4e ch 10; WHO mycetoma 2017; Khartoum MRC protocol

rx.instr: With full meal; check drug interactions; avoid in heart failure
